caption: The drawing features a single object centered within a rectangular frame, rendered in shades of grey and black; it appears to be a candlestick holder with a bell-shaped base and a broad, flat circular tray at the bottom for stability. The stem of the holder is narrow and flares out to support a cup-like structure that holds a vertical, cylindrical candle. Attached to the top is a short chain, which appears to connect a cap or snuffer that covers the candle, and to the right side of the tray is a circular handle or loop. The entire drawing is composed with fine lines and shading to give the appearance of a metallic texture. The background is plain and unshaded, and there is a signature "Hester Duany" at the lower right corner of the inner frame. The overall drawing is monochromatic, executed in pencil or graphite on light paper.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
